name: Niokolo-Koba National Park
description: Niokolo-Koba National Park spreads across southeastern Senegal near the Guinea border, where the Gambia river waters a mix of savannah and ribbons of dense gallery forest. It is one of West Africa's richest wildlife refuges, home to elephants, lions, leopards, chimpanzees and the Derby eland, the largest of the antelopes, along with many birds and reptiles.
